risks.risk: Console may not fully work (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Ethernet, power supply issues). Photos cannot confirm boot or gameplay.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the console powering on to the Xbox dashboard, plus a quick controller button/stick test.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully tested/possible faults until proven working.

risks.risk: Controllers may have drift, stuck buttons, or poor charging/connection.
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connected and responding in a game/menu (move sticks, press all buttons, D-pad).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as controllers may need repair/replacement until proven.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables (power cable, HDMI cable, headset, etc.). Seller text mentions a package but photos don’t show what’s included.
risks.proof: Clear photo of everything included laid out (power brick/cable, HDMI, controllers, any package items) with a close-up of model/labels on cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming only the console + 2 controllers, with other items not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Region/UK claim may not match what buyer receives (power plug type, included region-specific items).
risks.proof: Photo of the console power input label and the plug type/cable included.
risks.if_unproven: Price it without assuming any region-specific extras.

proof_requests: Video: console boots to Xbox dashboard (no error screens) and shows HDMI working.
Video: both controllers connected and fully responsive (sticks + all buttons).
Photo: all included items laid out (power cable/brick, HDMI, any FC26/package contents).
Photo: console serial/model label and power input label.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One console with two controllers, but they do not prove working condition or what the “FC26 package and other” includes—key factors that affect the real Lagos resale price.
